description: This file is a shell script used for setting up and testing a Subversion repository with multiple branches and tags, then cloning it using git-svn. It contains functions to initialize the repository, create branches and tags, and verify their existence.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, used to verify correct setup and cloning procedures.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to fail, used to verify error handling for invalid operations.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specified path is absent in the SVN checkout.
